description: Lists the problems test-inventory found while reading the test files: level error means tests may be missing from the other answers (a file that failed to parse, an import it could not follow), or that the runner fails the file or the run (a Vitest tag the config does not define, a .only that forbidOnly fails); level warning means a value is missing or approximate (a title built at run time, a config value computed at run time, a file no config runs). They are about reading the code, not test failures. Use it when another tool reports scanErrors, or to check why a test is missing or notLoaded. Answers are paged: follow nextCursor. Example: {"levels": ["error"]}.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous answer, for the next page. Keep the other arguments the same.

directory.description: A folder inside the project to scan, relative to its root, such as "packages/web". Default: the root.

expandCases.description: Lists each case of a .each or .for table and each pass of a loop as its own test, with the name the runner gives it and caseIndex, as the runner registers them. Ids differ from those without it, so pass the same value to get_tests. Default: false, one test per declaration with caseCount.

framework.description: The test runner. Default: the one the server was started with, otherwise the one the project in `directory` uses.

path.description: Keeps problems in this file, or in the files under this folder, relative to `directory`.

patterns.description: Globs of the test files, relative to `directory`, such as ["tests/**/*.spec.ts"]. Default: the ones the server was started with, or without them the files the configs in `directory` and below it run.

name: scan_diagnostics

columnStart.description: null for problems with the whole file.

lineStart.description: null for problems with the whole file.

source.description: Source text involved, shortened when long; null when none.

testId.description: The affected test; null when none.

DiagnosticLevel.description: `error`: tests may be missing from the output. `warning`: a value is missing or approximate.

diagnostics.description: One page of problems, in file order.

anyOf.description: What to do next, when there is something to say.
Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

total.description: All matching items, on every page.

title: Scan diagnostics
